description: Screenshot of a verified tweet by OAN correspondent Chanel Rion (@ChanelRion), October 15 2020, claiming she saw a behind-the-scenes look at the 'Hunter Biden hard drive' containing drugs, 'underage obsessions' and power deals, comparing Hunter Biden unfavorably to Anthony Weiner, and saying '#BidenCrimeFamily' and 'Big Tech' have apologizing to do. The tweet asserts these hard-drive characterizations without evidence shown.

description: Photograph of Donald Trump's January 20, 2017 presidential inauguration captioned in large red letters 'WE ARE Q!'. The elevated view from the U.S. Capitol's West Front shows Trump from behind walking down a blue-carpeted aisle toward the inaugural platform, with dignitaries standing on either side and a vast crowd stretching down the National Mall. The caption appropriates the inauguration image as a QAnon movement slogan.

Screenshot of Q drop #3485 (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, Jul 24 2019) which embeds screenshots of two earlier Q posts. The first (Mar 14 2019, No.5681798) claims Adam Schiff is part of the 'Gang of Eight' and questions whether he knowingly deceived the public about classified material. The second (Mar 28 2019, No.5943096) quotes a Trump tweet calling for Schiff's resignation and asserts that knowingly disseminating false information is illegal. The drop's own text repeats '[KNOWINGLY]' three times. All statements are the drops' claims.
